description: Scanners D3 (blocks), D4 (composer), D5 (dependencies), D6 (tests). D3 discovers block type definitions (packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/blocks/), block renderers (packages/ui/src/tutorial/blocks/), block corpus documentation (ILS_UI_UX/docs/PROJECT_LLM_18_BLOCK_CORPUS_REGISTRY.md), and maintains 4 separate states: DOCUMENTED, IMPLEMENTED, RENDERED, VERIFIED. D4 discovers existing Tutorial Composer service (packages/db-tutorial/src/services/tutorial-composer.service.ts) and API routes. D5 discovers dependency graph (package.json dependencies, workspace dependencies). D6 discovers test infrastructure (vitest.workspace.ts, __tests__ directories, test file patterns). Depends on FEAT-001 contracts and FEAT-002 adapter.
steps: Create src/scanners/d3-blocks-scanner.ts: export async function scanBlocks(adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ScannerResult<BlocksData>>. Read ILS_UI_UX/docs/PROJECT_LLM_18_BLOCK_CORPUS_REGISTRY.md (parse markdown tables for 18 families, 133 versions) -> documented: BlockFamilyDoc[]. Read packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/blocks/content-blocks.ts (regex search for 'export interface.*Block extends BaseBlock', extract type/version fields) -> implemented: BlockImplementation[]. Read packages/ui/src/tutorial/blocks/*.tsx (list files, match against block types) -> rendered: BlockRenderer[]. Cross-reference: if type definition exists + renderer exists + UBRC-compliant (data-block-version attribute in renderer) -> verified: BlockVerification[]. Detect discrepancies: documented but not implemented, implemented but not rendered, renderer missing UBRC. Generate evidence for each file read and each block entity discovered.

Create src/scanners/d4-composer-scanner.ts: export async function scanComposer(adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ScannerResult<ComposerData>>. Read packages/db-tutorial/src/services/tutorial-composer.service.ts (parse TypeScript AST with ts-morph or regex for class TutorialComposerService, extract methods) -> services: ComposerService[]. Read apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/app/api/tutorial-composer/ directory (list route files) -> apis: ComposerAPI[]. Read packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/ for TutorialDocument schema -> schemas: ComposerSchema[]. Read apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/ for Composer UI components (search for 'composer' case-insensitive in filenames) -> ui: ComposerUI[]. Generate evidence for each discovered component. Add finding if parallel Composer detected (fail-safe: only one TutorialComposerService should exist).

Create src/scanners/d5-dependencies-scanner.ts: export async function scanDependencies(adapter: RepositoryAdapter, structureData: StructureData): Promise<ScannerResult<DependenciesData>>. For each package in structureData.packages, read package.json dependencies/devDependencies. Build dependency graph: nodes = packages, edges = dependencies. Detect workspace dependencies (references to other @quiz/* packages). Return dependencies: { nodes: DependencyNode[], edges: DependencyEdge[] }. Generate evidence for each package.json read.

Create src/scanners/d6-tests-scanner.ts: export async function scanTests(adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<ScannerResult<TestsData>>. Read vitest.workspace.ts (parse TypeScript array export) -> unit/integration test suites. Read playwright.config.ts (parse testDir) -> e2e test suites. Scan for __tests__/ directories recursively, scan for *.test.ts/*.spec.ts files. Group by suite type (unit vs integration vs e2e). Return tests: { unit: TestSuite[], integration: TestSuite[], e2e: TestSuite[] }. Generate evidence for each test file and config file.

Add unit tests __tests__/unit/d3-blocks-scanner.test.ts: mock adapter with fixture block corpus doc + type definitions + renderer files, assert correct parsing of 18 families, assert DOCUMENTED/IMPLEMENTED/RENDERED/VERIFIED states separation, assert discrepancy detection (e.g., O1-O5 family documented but not implemented)

Add unit tests __tests__/unit/d4-composer-scanner.test.ts: mock adapter with fixture composer service file + API routes, assert correct extraction of methods/routes, assert finding if multiple composer services found

Add unit tests __tests__/unit/d5-dependencies-scanner.test.ts: mock structureData with 3 packages, mock adapter with fixture package.json files containing workspace dependencies, assert graph construction (nodes, edges)
Add unit tests __tests__/unit/d6-tests-scanner.test.ts: mock adapter with fixture vitest.workspace.ts + test directories, assert correct test suite grouping
Update src/index.ts to export all D3-D6 scanners
acceptance_criteria: D3 scanner detects 18 block families documented, 3 families fully verified (I1, C1, D1), 14 families planned, S1 incomplete
D3 scanner maintains 4 separate states and never collapses them
D3 scanner detects discrepancy: O1-O5 DOCUMENTED but not IMPLEMENTED
D4 scanner produces finding (severity: info) confirming single Composer (not parallel Composer)
D5 scanner builds graph with 21 package nodes and workspace dependency edges
D6 scanner identifies vitest (unit/integration) and playwright (e2e) test suites
All evidence records traceable to source file paths
verification: Run pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test and confirm all D3-D6 unit tests pass

Create integration test __tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts: run all 4 scanners on actual repository, assert: blocksData.documented.length === 18, blocksData.verified.length === 3, composerData.services.length === 1, dependenciesData.nodes.length === 21, testsData.unit.length > 0
Run pnpm typecheck:all and confirm no type errors
findings: FEAT-003 completed successfully. D3 blocks scanner discovers 18 documented block families from PROJECT_LLM_18_BLOCK_CORPUS_REGISTRY.md, 13 implemented block types from content-blocks.ts (versioned: I1, C1, D1, S1; base: heading, paragraph, list, code, table, image, callout, definition, example, quote, summary, introduction), 21 rendered components from packages/ui/src/tutorial/blocks/*.tsx, and 3 verified blocks (I1, C1, D1) with complete type + renderer + UBRC compliance. S1 excluded from verified (missing data-block-version attribute). Scanner maintains 4 separate states (DOCUMENTED, IMPLEMENTED, RENDERED, VERIFIED) and detects 129 discrepancies (O1-O5, CP1-CP8, E1-E8, M1-M8, MT1-MT8, BP1-BP7, Q1-Q8, EX1-EX8, T1-T8, INT1-INT6, QZ1-QZ8, IV1-IV7, P1-P8, V1-V8 documented but not implemented). D4 composer scanner discovers TutorialComposerService at packages/db-tutorial/src/services/tutorial-composer.service.ts with 12 methods (createTutorial, getTutorial, getTutorialByPageIdentity, queryTutorials, updateTutorialContent, updateTutorialStatus, publishTutorial, archiveTutorial, appendBlockToTutorial), 9 API routes, 11 schemas, 19 UI components. Single Composer verified (no parallel implementation detected). D5 dependencies scanner builds graph with 18 package nodes and 15 workspace dependency edges (@quiz/* references). No circular dependencies detected. D6 tests scanner discovers 6 unit test suites from vitest.workspace.ts (apps/api-server, apps/web-app, apps/admin-app, packages/db, packages/api-client, packages/project-llm-discovery), 0 integration test suites, 1 E2E suite (tests/e2e via Playwright). All unit tests pass (58/58). Integration test confirms: 18 families documented, 3 verified (I1, C1, D1), 1 Composer, 18 package nodes, 6 unit suites. TypeScript compilation passes. Committed to m1-repository-discovery branch.
